blurb: Lynn Creek Marina offers a variety of boat rentals including pontoons, deck boats, fishing boats, and party boats. The marina provides amenities such as a restaurant, ship store, golf range, and boat slips. Guests can enjoy fishing, cruising, tubing, tanning, and parties on the water.
extraNote: $44 non-refundable damage waiver fee required on all motorized vessels · Check-in is located in the Marina Store
